Paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators of generated outputs. LLMs (GPT-2) are used for generation only.

guideline: Workers judge generated questions on three criteria: (1) validity (grammatically correct, complete, comprehensible), (2) relevance to highlighted span, (3) whether question is already answered in prior context
